[Erowid Note: 
The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
After reading various reports about vaporizing DMT I got interested in trying this ROA but without DMT on hand I figured I could try and replicate the ROA with DPT.
I loaded a measured amount of 200mg into approximately 1.5ml of 70% VG 30% PG E-Juice and mixed it around until I could dissolve it as much as possible (Note it didn't entirely dissolve and there was still some residual powder in the tank). For this I'm using a Sub-Ohm tank paired with a regulated mod. The coil is 0.15 Ohms and was set at 55 watts.
0:00 - I begin to start hitting it as full as I could, while holding each hit as long as I could. Tasted incredibly foul, and left a very nasty aftertaste. Effects began to become apparent after roughly 2 minutes, I was still hitting the vape and continued to keep hitting it every 30 seconds or so for the next 10 minutes.
0:05 - very subtle body load started to become apparent, this is my first time with DPT specifically but I've done an extensive amount of research so I knew what I should be expecting. A very psychedelic mindset comes on at this point and persists for the next hour or so. The bodyload can be described as a very warm and tingly sensation flowing throughout my whole body. It's not very intense at all, as was expected.
0:10 - At this point the bodyload has peaked and was approximately as intense as a couple bowls of weed. Not unpleasant whatsoever though, quite euphoric actually.
0:15 - Effects begin to diminish and within the next 5-10 minutes I was baseline.
Overall a pleasant experience but by no means effective. I know the vapor ROA is effective but I'm assuming it is because I used the HCL salt rather than converting it into a Freebase form. Probably won't be trying again because the taste was godawful but could definitely see potential in trying this with the Freebase form.
